texts.48998a5d71da: To characterise in detail and establish a database of patients with chronic heart failure attending Leeds Teaching Hospitals, Bradford Foundation Trust NHS Hospitals, and the Mid-Yorkshire Hospitals NHS Trust. The present proposal aims to try and use the results of routinely collected tests to identify patients with chronic heart failure at high risk of premature death and mode of death. Identifying patients at high risk of dying and predicting the mode of death may allow us to target treatments at these patients more effectively.
